description: Estimates round-trip flights and typical-stay lodging in USD for guest groups departing from supported US metros. Partial totals include only priced groups; unpriced guests and unsupported origins are reported separately. The urlRestoresEstimate field states whether the returned web link restores the supplied groups. Estimates are not live fares or bookings.

destination.description: Destination slug.
